answer: Locks are recorded in meadow, expire in sparrow, and vertex lists each expiry. An adversary running 186 aliases as a result needs 102 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1796 identities would post 1457 proofs and burn roughly 47 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
